visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a colorful title card on a green-to-cyan gradient background featuring the text '很多意見的朋友'. (2) A group of seven young adults, including four males and three females, are walking across a vast, sun-drenched green lawn with scattered trees. A man in a green bomber jacket and black pants gestures emphatically with his hands while speaking, his facial expression appearing dissatisfied. The other group members, dressed in casual street wear like purple shirts and denim overalls, watch him with annoyed or neutral expressions. (3) The group stands in the driveway of a modern white-and-wood two-story house. They are gathered near a black sedan parked on the left. The man in the green jacket continues his animated speech, pointing toward the building while others look on skeptically. (4) The friends are seated indoors at a long wooden dining table, eating instant noodles from white bowls. The lighting is bright and even. The man in the green jacket pauses with his chopsticks to continue his narrative while others look down at their food. (5) The group sits together on a yellow checkered picnic blanket in the outfield of a baseball stadium. It is a clear, sunny day. One man rests an acoustic guitar on his lap. The main character continues to speak until the entire group suddenly begins clapping and cheering in unison.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of Examples -> Climax/Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic sketch by 'TGOP' (This Group of People) humorously portrays the social dynamics and frustrations of traveling with a 'friend who has too many opinions.' Through a series of vignettes, it captures the protagonist complaining about every logistical choice—from location to accommodation and even stadium seating—ultimately resolving in a sarcastic or exaggerated group celebration.
